summary_en: Board resolution on 21 Aug 2026 updating measures to realize capital-cost and share-price-conscious management. Specific targets and KPIs deferred to attached materials (not provided in excerpt).
title_en: Update on Measures to Realize Capital-Cost and Share-Price-Conscious Management
translation_en_brief: On 21 August 2026, Bull-Dog Sauce's board of directors passed a resolution updating the company's measures and specific initiatives to realize capital-cost and share-price-conscious management. The filing is a TDnet announcement of that update decision. The first two pages provide the standard corporate notice structure (date, representatives, enquiry contact) and confirm that detailed content has been updated and will be found in the attached materials. The specific financial targets, KPI definitions, execution timeline, and underlying rationale are not included in the excerpt provided—they appear in the full attachment referenced in the disclosure.
